title: SAFE NEUROSYMBOLIC LEARNING WITH DIFFERENTIABLE SYMBOLIC EXECUTION
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical challenge of ensuring 'safety' (defined as satisfying safety requirements on worst-case inputs) in neurosymbolic programs.
